recommendations.title: Finish one deployable dashboard vertical slice
recommendations.reason: The backend and authentication component are already tested, but they do not create user value until the banner, session bootstrap, dashboard shell, and core data states work together. Completing this slice removes the largest gap between 109 green tests and a usable application.
recommendations.action: Complete IA-009 and FE-004 through FE-009 in checklist order: wire InstagramAuthBanner into the authenticated layout, implement login/session bootstrap, then render loading, empty, error, populated KPI, and reel-list/detail states. Run the focused Vitest tests after each step and the full Python plus frontend suites before moving on.

recommendations.title: Close the production-build gate before touching deployment
recommendations.reason: Deployment work will otherwise compound frontend integration errors with Docker, Caddy, DNS, and VPS variables. A clean typecheck and production bundle provide an objective handoff point and keep the procedure surgical.
recommendations.action: After the core dashboard screens pass, implement the pipeline tab and accessibility fallbacks, then run the frontend typecheck, complete Vitest suite, and npm production build. Record the exact outputs in IMPLEMENTATION_CHECKLIST.md before starting Docker or VPS changes.

recommendations.title: Prepare the live Instagram verification as a bounded operator step
recommendations.reason: IA-008 requires Chris's real approved secondary-account cookies and cannot be honestly automated or guessed. Preparing a short, secure verification window now prevents this credential-dependent gate from surprising the deployment sequence later.
recommendations.action: When the dashboard is locally buildable, ask Chris to supply sessionid and ds_user_id through the in-dashboard form during a live test window. Verify only the resulting whoami state and account identity, never log or repeat cookie values, and mark IA-008 complete only after the dev-VPS round-trip succeeds.

non_negotiable.title: Complete IA-009 and prove the integrated dashboard shell today
